points.point: Should the messaging permission be unchecked to get past it
Two live DM automations on the account

verdict.reason: No entry covers the "isn't eligible" reconnect error. The follow-gate entry says to leave messaging checked when reconnecting, but only in the context of a stuck follow gate, and none of the entries say what unchecking the permission does to live DM automations, so this needs a person on the team.
